rules.content:
index=transactions (payment_type="wire" OR payment_type="crypto_purchase" OR payment_type="zelle")
    (recipient_category="investment" OR recipient_category="crypto_exchange" OR recipient_category="unknown_platform")
| bin _time span=7d
| stats sum(amount) as weekly_total count as weekly_count by account_id, _time
| sort 0 account_id _time
| streamstats window=4 values(weekly_total) as weekly_history by account_id
| eval prev_avg=mvindex(weekly_history, 0)
| eval current=weekly_total
| where current > prev_avg * 2 AND weekly_count >= 2
| eval total_invested=sum(weekly_total)
| table account_id, _time, weekly_total, weekly_count, prev_avg, current
| sort - current
rules.title: Splunk — Progressive Investment Deposit Escalation (Phase 3-4)

rules.content:
title: Sequential Fee/Tax Payments to Investment Entity - Pig Butchering Indicator
status: experimental
description: Detects multiple payments described as fees, taxes, or compliance requirements to investment-related entities, consistent with withdrawal denial extraction in pig butchering scams.
logsource:
    product: payment_system
    service: transactions
detection:
    selection_type:
        payment_type:
            - 'wire'
            - 'zelle'
            - 'crypto_purchase'
    selection_description:
        transaction_description|contains:
            - 'tax'
            - 'fee'
            - 'compliance'
            - 'insurance deposit'
            - 'verification'
            - 'anti-money laundering'
    selection_category:
        recipient_category:
            - 'investment'
            - 'crypto_exchange'
            - 'unknown_platform'
    timeframe: 30d
    condition: selection_type AND selection_description AND selection_category | count() by account_id > 2
level: critical
tags:
    - fraud.investment_scam
    - fraud.pig_butchering
    - cfpf.phase4.execution
rules.title: Sigma — Fee/Tax Payment Pattern Detection (Phase 4)

rules.content:
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.transaction_date,
    t.amount,
    t.payment_type,
    t.recipient_description,
    fs.funding_source_type,
    fs.funding_date,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, fs.funding_date, t.transaction_date) AS days_from_funding
FROM transactions t
JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           transaction_date as funding_date,
           CASE
               WHEN description LIKE '%retirement%' OR description LIKE '%401k%' OR description LIKE '%IRA%' THEN 'retirement_liquidation'
               WHEN description LIKE '%HELOC%' OR description LIKE '%home equity%' THEN 'home_equity'
               WHEN description LIKE '%personal loan%' OR description LIKE '%credit line%' THEN 'personal_loan'
               ELSE 'other_unusual'
           END as funding_source_type
    FROM transactions
    WHERE (description LIKE '%retirement%' OR description LIKE '%401k%' OR description LIKE '%IRA%'
           OR description LIKE '%HELOC%' OR description LIKE '%home equity%'
           OR description LIKE '%personal loan%' OR description LIKE '%credit line%')
      AND transaction_type = 'inbound'
      AND transaction_date > DATEADD(DAY, -90, GETDATE())
) fs ON t.account_id = fs.account_id
WHERE t.recipient_category IN ('investment', 'crypto_exchange', 'unknown_platform')
  AND t.transaction_date > fs.funding_date
  AND DATEDIFF(DAY, fs.funding_date, t.transaction_date) <= 30
ORDER BY t.amount DESC;
rules.title: SQL — Unusual Funding Source for Investment Activity (Phase 3)
